findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_leaders, get_crypto_night, get_crypto_night_live, get_engine_feed · Private data: get_market_leaders_live, get_market_regime_live, get_buy_list_live, get_stock_read_live, get_sector_read_live, get_crypto_trend_live, get_morning_brief_live, get_day_board_live, get_rotation_live, get_crypto_day_live, get_crypto_night_live, get_hold_state_live, get_engine_feed, get_product_details, checkout_handoff, search_policies · Public sink: get_market_leaders, get_crypto_night, get_crypto_night_live, get_crypto_setups, get_crypto_setups_live, get_engine_feed, get_live_setup · Destructive: remove_from_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_leaders, get_crypto_night, get_crypto_night_live, get_engine_feed · Private data: get_market_leaders_live, get_market_regime_live, get_buy_list_live, get_stock_read_live, get_sector_read_live, get_crypto_trend_live, get_morning_brief_live, get_day_board_live, get_rotation_live, get_crypto_day_live, get_crypto_night_live, get_hold_state_live, get_engine_feed, get_product_details, checkout_handoff, search_policies · Public sink: get_market_leaders, get_crypto_night, get_crypto_night_live, get_crypto_setups, get_crypto_setups_live, get_engine_feed, get_live_setup · Destructive: remove_from_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
